title: Dick Russell's day-long interview with Sidney Gottlieb

tellings.quote: has one of the only interviews, as far as I know, with Sidney Gottlieb. He spent a whole day with him.

plain: In the 1990s, the writer Dick Russell spent a whole day at the home of Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA scientist who ran its mind-control experiments, and came away with one of the only interviews Gottlieb ever gave. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this as something he knows of Russell's work, and it matters because almost no one ever got Gottlieb to talk.
